intent: Targeted edit of round04 approved artwork

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent original T-shirt artwork, targeted spacing revision.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the approved CAR: WRONG Heritage artwork. Preserve this design closely.
Primary request: increase the clear breathing room BETWEEN the upper copy and cabinet/car illustration, and BETWEEN the illustration and lower copy. The cabinet crown must no longer nearly touch PERFECT, and the feet/tires must no longer nearly touch CAR: WRONG.
Composition: preserve the existing outer composition width and roughly its current total height. Keep the top arched two-line setup and lower payoff in their existing relative outer positions. Modestly reduce ONLY the entire cabinet+car object group uniformly by approximately 15–18 percent, keep the cabinet-to-car proportion and relationship unchanged, center that group optically between the two text blocks. This should create plainly visible yet restrained empty gaps above and below the illustration—roughly 0.4–0.5 of the lower line's capital height. Do not make the overall composition taller. Keep it a unified heritage emblem, not disconnected panels.
Text verbatim: "WIDTH & HEIGHT:" arched at top; "PERFECT." directly beneath as the combined setup; "CAR: WRONG." as the classic serif lower anchor. Preserve the existing classic serif type character and weight; do not bolden the payoff. Retain muted terracotta/rose lettering and slate-blue monochrome objects. Do not change the lettering to playful or a straight stack.
Illustration invariants: same distinctive ornate antique cabinet with little hanging price tag, same generic anonymous small open-hatch car; keep their silhouettes, style, relative scale, orientation and recognizable transport mismatch. No brand logo. No added imagery. Preserve the one-color object drawing and restrained print-friendly heritage character. No new decorative borders, dates or flourishes.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no shirt, no background color or panel, no white rectangle, no checkerboard pixels. Retain all artwork fully within the canvas with a little transparent edge padding.
The ONLY creative change is internal copy-to-graphic spacing through a modest uniform reduction/repositioning of the object group. Do not redesign the typography, wording, palette, objects, or overall outer proportions.
attempts.decision: Rejected by Creative Director: payoff became heavier and lower separation remained limited.

attempts.prompt:
Precise edit of the attached transparent Heritage T-shirt artwork. Preserve the exact original letterforms, words, thin-to-thick contrast and weight of ALL typography. Especially preserve the elegant moderate-weight classic serif "CAR: WRONG." exactly; do NOT make its vertical strokes heavier, do NOT replace it with bold slab/block lettering.

Change the interior layout only: uniformly shrink the blue cabinet-and-car illustration group to approximately 80% of its current size and center that group between the existing top and bottom text blocks. Keep typography scale and outer position unchanged. This reduction should create a clear open gap of approximately HALF A CAPITAL LETTER HEIGHT between "PERFECT." and the cabinet crown, and HALF A CAPITAL LETTER HEIGHT between the lowest wheel/foot and "CAR: WRONG." Both gaps must remain obvious when the art is viewed small. The previous tiny lower gap is insufficient.

Preserve the original outer width and height of the total composition; do not extend it vertically. Preserve the arched WIDTH & HEIGHT: with PERFECT. beneath. Preserve the verbatim text "WIDTH & HEIGHT:" / "PERFECT." / "CAR: WRONG.". Preserve muted rose/terracotta lettering and slate-blue monochrome objects. Preserve the same ornate antique cabinet, hanging price tag, generic small open-hatch car, cabinet/car proportion, orientation and original engraving style. Keep the central group prominent and the emblem cohesive.
No new elements or decorations. No garment mockup. True transparent background, no solid fill. This is a restrained spacing adjustment to an approved design; typography and style should remain as close to the original as possible.
attempts.decision: Selected for Founder review: clearer upper/lower gaps, moderate classic serif, same overall footprint.

limitations: Generated edits are not pixel-identical to the source outside spacing; minor letterform/linework drift remains. No source artwork was edited with raster scripts.
